phases.name: Vision & feasibility
phases.description: Prove a small, distinctive game is viable before committing to production.

checklist.text: Audience, comparable games and player promise
Core loop, design pillars and explicit scope exclusions
Platforms, engine, controls and accessibility goals
Budget, runway, team capacity and highest risks
Pitch, success measures and go / no-go decision

ai_actions.name: Plan vision & feasibility
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Prototype & game design
phases.description: Test the riskiest mechanics with disposable greybox builds.

checklist.text: Version control, backups and reproducible build setup
Playable core loop with placeholder art and audio
External playtests with observed behaviour and findings
Game design: systems, progression, economy, narrative and levels
Prototype review: keep, change or stop with evidence

ai_actions.name: Plan prototype & game design
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Pre-production & sprint planning
phases.description: Set production standards and a repeatable delivery process.

checklist.text: Technical architecture, save data and online requirements
Art bible, visual references, audio direction and naming conventions
Ordered backlog with acceptance criteria, owners and dependencies
Sprint goal, capacity, estimates and definition of done
Performance budgets, asset specifications and pipeline test

ai_actions.name: Plan pre-production & sprint planning
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Asset design & 3D production
phases.description: Start here for photo-based assets. Keep reference views, editable geometry and production requirements together.

checklist.text: Create an asset inventory linked to levels, gameplay and backlog tasks
Upload one photo or three views per asset; label each row on asset sheets
Record dimensions, scale, pivot, rights and uncertain hidden surfaces
Build editable shapes or custom meshes and compare all reference views
Review silhouette, materials, triangle count and export geometry
Plan UVs, texture baking, LODs, collision, rigs and animations; verify in the target engine

ai_actions.name: Build assets from reference photos
ai_actions.description: Read project forms and the asset queue, inspect the attached photo or three-view reference set, model each asset using save_game_asset and existing library tools, and report assumptions and unfinished engine checks.

phases.name: Vertical slice
phases.description: Deliver a small representative section to validate quality, cost and pipeline.

checklist.text: Integrate representative art, gameplay, UI, sound, lighting and VFX
Import models into the target engine and test scale, pivots and collisions
Playtest the complete loop including onboarding, saves and failure
Profile the slice on minimum target hardware
Review quality bar, production rate and revised scope before scaling

ai_actions.name: Plan vertical slice
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Production sprints
phases.description: Repeat small playable increments across code, content and audio.

checklist.text: Plan a sprint goal and select capacity-sized backlog items
Implement mechanics, levels, quests, UI, audio, VFX and animation
Run integration builds, code review and asset validation continuously
Review a playable increment against acceptance criteria
Retrospective: improve the process, reorder backlog and repeat

ai_actions.name: Plan production sprints
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Alpha & content complete
phases.description: Reach an end-to-end playable game and close remaining content gaps.

checklist.text: All core systems and full game progression playable
Complete content inventory, localization preparation and credits
Test saves, upgrades, input devices and multiplayer if applicable
Triage defects by severity, impact and reproduction evidence
Alpha exit: documented gaps, known issues and scope freeze

ai_actions.name: Plan alpha & content complete
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Beta, optimization & release candidate
phases.description: Validate quality on real hardware and prepare a releasable build.

checklist.text: External beta testing across the supported device matrix
Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, loading and asset budgets
Accessibility, localization, security and compatibility checks
Regression, crash reporting, analytics and save migration checks
Release candidate with no blocking defects and rollback plan

ai_actions.name: Plan beta, optimization & release candidate
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Publishing & launch
phases.description: Prepare discovery throughout development; finalize release assets here.

checklist.text: Store page, trailer, screenshots, demo and community plan
Verify asset licences, credits, age ratings and platform disclosures
Complete platform store and build reviews against current requirements
Verify achievements, pricing, launch communications and support readiness
Release approval, deployment checklist and rollback rehearsal

ai_actions.name: Plan publishing & launch
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.

phases.name: Live support & retrospective
phases.description: Maintain the shipped game and use evidence to choose what comes next.

checklist.text: Monitor crashes, player feedback, support and performance
Triage hotfixes; test patches and preserve save compatibility
Review player outcomes and reorder the post-launch backlog
Ship updates, community communication and localization improvements
Postmortem, financial review, archive and next-project lessons

ai_actions.name: Plan live support & retrospective
ai_actions.description: Read saved project context and evidence; draft a practical plan, tasks, acceptance criteria and open questions for this milestone.
